infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SafeHer sends your live location to responders during an emergency.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SafeHer keeps sending your location while an emergency is open, even if the screen is off.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SafeHer records audio evidence from just before an alert is raised.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SafeHer captures snapshots during an emergency so responders can see the scene.
